empirical_support.basis: Three independent deployments contrasting a specialized technical DM campaign against two general personal broadcasts. Results are highly polarized as expected.

scope_stability.basis: Results heavily confounded by delivery mechanism (DM vs. broadcast) and audience scale (known personal network vs. algorithmically mediated).

remaining_uncertainties: EXP_019 on Reddit (a specialized community broadcast) is currently pending observation, which will isolate the 'specialized' variable from the 'DM' variable.
No controlled payload replication across platforms.
next_discriminating_experiment: Complete observation of EXP_019 on Reddit to see if a specialized community responds to a broadcast offer, isolating the effect of 'specialized audience' from 'DM delivery mechanism'.
